description: Complete rewrite of SalesOrders.tsx and Invoices.tsx pages removing ALL mock data, plus new Returns.tsx and Payments.tsx pages, routing, sidebar updates, and dashboard sales widgets
steps: REWRITE src/pages/sales/SalesOrders.tsx: Remove all mockOrders. Wire to useSalesOrders() hook for data. Status-filtered tabs (All, Draft, Confirmed, Processing, Shipped, Delivered). DataTable with order_number, customer name (from join), items count, total_amount, status Badge, created_at date. 'New Order' multi-step dialog (5 steps): 1) Select customer (searchable via useCustomers), 2) Select warehouse (via useWarehouses), 3) Add products (search products, add rows with quantity/price/discount), 4) Review totals (subtotal, tax 18%, discount, grand total), 5) Confirm creates draft via useCreateSalesOrder. Order detail Sheet panel with: full order info, line items table, status stepper (connected dots with emerald progress line), action buttons per status (Draft: Confirm/Cancel, Confirmed: Process/Cancel, Processing: Ship, Shipped: Mark Delivered), invoice section if generated (view/download/email), payment section (record payment form + history), return button if delivered. Bulk actions for confirming multiple drafts. All with glassmorphism styling, motion animations, loading skeletons, toast notifications via sonner.

REWRITE src/pages/sales/Invoices.tsx: Remove all mockInvoices. Wire to useInvoices() hook. Invoice list DataTable: invoice_number, order reference, customer, amount, paid amount, balance, status badge (unpaid=red, partial=amber, paid=green, overdue=red with animate-pulse, refunded=purple), date. Invoice detail Sheet panel: dark-themed invoice preview mimicking PDF layout, payment history table, 'Record Payment' button opening payment form dialog, 'Download PDF' calling PHP backend, 'Email Invoice' calling PHP email, outstanding balance display. Filters: status select, customer select, date range. Summary stats cards at top: total invoiced, total collected, total outstanding.

Create NEW src/pages/sales/Returns.tsx: Returns management page. 'New Return' button opening dialog: select delivered order (from useReturns data), shows order items with delivered quantities, input return quantity per item + reason dropdown + condition dropdown, notes field, submit calls useInitiateReturn(). Returns DataTable: return_number, order ref, customer, status badge (pending=amber, approved=blue, completed=green, rejected=red), refund amount, date. Detail Sheet panel: return items table, Approve/Reject buttons (if pending), stock restoration confirmation when approved. Dark glassmorphism styling throughout.

Create NEW src/pages/sales/Payments.tsx: Payment tracking dashboard. Summary KPI cards: total received this month, total outstanding, overdue amount, collection rate %. Recent payments DataTable: date, invoice number, customer, amount, payment method badge, reference. Outstanding invoices list with days overdue calculation. 'Record Payment' quick action button. Charts section: monthly collection trend (Recharts BarChart), payment method breakdown (Recharts PieChart). All with glassmorphism design.
Update src/App.tsx: Add lazy imports for Returns and Payments pages, add routes: 'sales/returns' -> Returns, 'sales/payments' -> Payments.

Update src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx: Add to Sales section navSections items: { title: 'Returns', href: '/sales/returns', icon: RotateCcw } and { title: 'Payments', href: '/sales/payments', icon: CreditCard }. Import RotateCcw and CreditCard from lucide-react.

Update src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Add sales KPI widgets row after existing CRM widgets row. Include: 'Revenue This Month' (sum of paid invoices via useInvoices or static), 'Outstanding Payments' (with overdue warning styling), 'Orders to Ship' count (processing status orders), monthly revenue trend mini-chart (small AreaChart or bar). Use the same KPICard component and motion animation pattern.
acceptance_criteria: SalesOrders.tsx has ZERO mock data - all data comes from hooks
Invoices.tsx has ZERO mock data - all data comes from hooks
New Returns.tsx page renders with proper data hooks
New Payments.tsx page renders with charts and data hooks
Sidebar shows Returns and Payments items under Sales section
Dashboard has new sales widgets row
All pages use glassmorphism dark theme consistently
Status badges use correct color variants
pnpm build passes with zero TypeScript errors
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm zero errors
findings: Build passes with zero TS errors. Vite build succeeds. The tsc binary is located at node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc and vite at node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js (not in .bin). Used 'node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b' and 'node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build' for verification. All pages use real hooks with zero mock data. The Invoices hook returns Invoice[] directly (not paginated response), same with Returns and Payments hooks.
